name: Budgeted-GS
definition: A post-hoc method that turns any trained 3DGS model into a factoring tree (a multi-resolution hierarchy of moment-matched aggregates) to enable real-time rendering of city-scale scenes on consumer GPUs by selecting the level of detail that fits the target device's memory.
summary: Budgeted-GS converts 3D Gaussian Splatting models into multi-resolution hierarchies using a capacity floor to dynamically select detail levels, enabling city-scale rendering on consumer GPUs with varying memory.
